title: Ankhorage Book
summary: Standalone toolkit and CLI for creating, importing, validating, previewing, and exporting editable book projects.
purpose: Turn PDF, EPUB, or Markdown material into an editable book project and produce validated EPUB and PDF output through one standalone workflow.
responsibilities: Create and read editable book projects.
Import supported PDF, EPUB, and Markdown sources with an import report.
Validate project structure and content before output.
Preview and export EPUB and PDF artifacts.
Expose the workflow through package APIs and Ankh CLI capabilities.
boundaries: Does not require a sibling repository or hidden workspace to create or export a book.
Does not own a hosted publishing, sales, or digital-rights-management service.
Does not treat generated EPUB or PDF files as the editable source of truth.
audience: Authors and editors preparing portable book projects.
Automation and CLI users converting or validating book content.
useCases: Initialize a new editable book project.
Import an existing PDF, EPUB, or Markdown manuscript.
Validate, preview, and export the project as EPUB and PDF.

architecture.role: Feature-first tooling package with application operations for project, import, validation, and export plus a thin CLI provider.
invariants: Editable project data remains separate from generated output formats.
Format-specific libraries stay behind the importing, previewing, and exporting feature boundaries.
